instruction: Speak in Spanish. Imagine you've been running and have to get this message out immediately. Your voice should be panting and breathless.
text: Rápido, coge tus cosas y vámonos. Te lo cuento por el camino, ¡muévete!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio does not sound panting or breathless at all; the speaker uses a normal, steady voice.

instruction_evidence.dysphonia: There is no audible breathlessness, gasping, or panting in the delivery.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Perform this with a weak, tired voice that lacks energy. Let your breath support fail, causing your voice to trail off at the end of phrases.
text: A veces me pregunto si todo el esfuerzo ha merecido la pena... o si solo era un sueño.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio features a continuously weak and tired voice, with noticeable drops in energy and breath support at the ends of phrases, perfectly matching the instruction.

instruction_evidence.dysphonia: The speaker maintains a low-energy, tired voice throughout the recording.
instruction_evidence.breath_support: The voice trails off and becomes breathier at the ends of phrases, successfully simulating failing breath support.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The weak, tired voice sounds highly natural and realistic, without sounding artificially processed.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The vocal delivery effectively and convincingly conveys the melancholic and exhausted tone of the text.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Say this with a voice that is trembling with fear, as if you're confessing something terrible and are scared of the consequences.
text: Fui yo quien estaba allí esa noche... no quería decirlo pero ya no puedo ocultarlo.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker consistently maintains a trembling, fearful voice throughout the entire sentence, perfectly matching the instruction.

instruction_evidence.dysphonia: The voice has a continuous, clear tremolo and shakiness, especially noticeable on sustained vowels, indicating fear.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The trembling effect sounds very organic and is well-integrated without sounding artificial.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional delivery is highly convincing, perfectly capturing the fear and anxiety of a terrible confession.
